models_evaluated: publicly available generative AI system (unnamed in text)

links.outcome: Accuracy of AI diagnosis of transfusion reaction categories versus expert panel and TM specialists
links.effect: Overall accuracy 48.7% for AI versus 72.1% for prior TM specialist responses (p = 0.005); no correct identification in some NHSN categories such as DSTR.
links.quote: Overall accuracy among all diagnostic categories was 48.7% for AI responses versus 72.1% for prior TM specialist responses (p = 0.005).

screen.reason: Evaluates the diagnostic accuracy and safety/limitations of a generative AI system on 36 hypothetical clinical vignettes of transfusion reactions against human experts without testing a specific organizational safeguard or deployment intervention.
